reported_impact: Survey respondents cited insufficient household water delivery with high shares in North Beqaa Baalbek-Hermel and Beirut.
routing_takeaway: Generate outage and low-supply evals that ask for municipality and distinguish public WE network from private source.
privacy_notes: Aggregated survey only; no names or account details.

reported_impact: 35% of surveyed households reported not receiving water from the WE network in the prior month.
routing_takeaway: Model should accept long-duration public-network outage complaints and avoid promising restoration times.

reported_impact: Survey reports most households in Akkar and North did not receive WE network water in the last month.
routing_takeaway: Route public-network complaints to NLWE after municipality confirmation; keep private wells and trucked water separate.

reported_location_or_scope: North Lebanon and Tripoli focus-group context
reported_impact: Survey and focus-group evidence reports very poor perceived WE water quality and unanswered maintenance calls in the North.
routing_takeaway: For NLWE dirty-water cases collect subscriber number address photos/smell/color and give phone plus walk-in fallback without promising callback.

reported_impact: Focus-group evidence says East Zahle supply is low and some residents use neighboring village networks or buy private tanks.
routing_takeaway: For BWE cases ask if property is connected to public network and whether complaint concerns public supply or private tanker/source.

reported_impact: Residents and delivery drivers reported early and heavy private water-truck demand during tightening restrictions and low rainfall.
routing_takeaway: Public-network outage remains BMLWE by location; private truck pricing or delivery dispute is not a WE repair complaint.
privacy_notes: Media reports; no individual PII stored.

reported_location_or_scope: Metn Tallet el-Khayat Bourj Abi Haidar Bourj Hammoud and BMLWE pump stations
reported_impact: BMLWE-area water cutoffs were linked to electricity shortages affecting Mechref Naameh Damour Jeita and Dbayeh pumping stations.
routing_takeaway: Route as BMLWE public water outage while noting power dependency; do not auto-route to EDL unless the user reports a separate electricity fault.

reported_impact: South Lebanon water board described multi-day shortages due to public electricity stoppage affecting production wells and distribution stations.
routing_takeaway: Route to SLWE by location and include conservation/low-confidence timing language; no official repair SLA.

reported_impact: SLWE said repeated Tyre-area water interruptions were due to public electricity interruption and that its facilities were otherwise operational when power was available.
routing_takeaway: Route as SLWE public water outage with electricity-dependency context; avoid blaming private plumbing unless building-only evidence exists.

reported_impact: SLWE announced restoration after maintenance connected Bass station to distribution networks and repaired damage from an airstrike.
routing_takeaway: Conflict-damage outages require SLWE plus HITL/emergency sensitivity; repairs may involve municipalities or ICRC but citizen routing remains SLWE for network supply.
privacy_notes: Public media report; no victim identities retained.

reported_impact: Cholera traces were reported in Tripoli sources and NLWE said the source was a private well not monitored by the government and not its public network.
routing_takeaway: Dirty-water or disease complaints need source ownership check; private well contamination is public-health/HITL and not ordinary NLWE network repair.
privacy_notes: Public incident report; no individual names stored.

reported_impact: Residents and suppliers reported dried wells and salty or discolored water amid drought and overuse.
routing_takeaway: Ask whether dirty/salty water comes from public network private well tanker or building tank before routing; public network goes BMLWE and private source goes HITL/public health or private provider boundary.

reported_impact: UNICEF story describes a leaking main supply sending water into property foundations before repair and connection work.
routing_takeaway: Public main leaks damaging property route to BWE with evidence photos and exact location; private building damage is secondary follow-up.
privacy_notes: Institutional story; no resident identity stored.

reported_impact: Institutional sources and media describe households relying on private trucks when public systems fail or ration supply.
routing_takeaway: Router should distinguish complaint about missing public water from complaint about private water vendor cost or quality.

reported_impact: Survey reports low trust in WE employees to solve public water supply issues and Tripoli participants mentioned unanswered maintenance calls.
routing_takeaway: Eval should cover citizens saying they tried calling and nobody answered; response should offer alternative official channels and HITL when safety/health risk exists.
privacy_notes: Aggregated survey and focus-group evidence only.
